notes: Repeated census expression at 3:22 and 39 is condensed; second occurrence is contextual, not a second lexical equivalence. In 3:26 'all' is repositioned by the LSG; 'tabernacle' clarifies the pronominal referent. 3:47 second occurrence of shekel is implicit. Compound numbers and name spellings preserved; 3:50 supplies the monetary unit in French.
